mapper.sql: ESS.APPLY_PARAM_NO, ESS.APPLY_TYPE, GET_CODE_NAME(ESS.APPLY_TYPE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS APPLY_NAME, ESS.EMP_TYPE, ESS.DUTY_NO, CASE WHEN ESS.DUTY_NO = 'Q' THEN NULL ELSE GET_GLOBAL_NAME(ESS.DUTY_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) END AS DUTY_NAME, ESS.AFFIRM_LEVEL, ESS.LOW_LEVEL, (SELECT LISTAGG(GET_GLOBAL_NAME(L.DUTY, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY L.DUTY) FROM SY_AFFIRM_LEVEL_SETUP L WHERE L.AFFIRM_LEVEL = ESS.LOW_LEVEL AND L.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS LOW_LEVEL_NAME, ESS.HIGH_LEVEL, (SELECT LISTAGG(GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.DUTY, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY H.DUTY) FROM SY_AFFIRM_LEVEL_SETUP H WHERE H.AFFIRM_LEVEL = ESS.HIGH_LEVEL AND H.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS HIGH_LEVEL_NAME
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_PARAM (APPLY_PARAM_NO, REFERENCN_FROM_FLAG, REFERENCN_FROM_OFFSET, REFERENCN_FROM_RELATION, REFERENCN_TO_OFFSET, APPLY_TYPE, DUTY_NO, AFFIRM_LEVEL, ACTIVITY, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CPNY_ID, LOW_LEVEL, HIGH_LEVEL, TYPE, EMP_TYPE) VALUES (ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_PARAM_SEQ.NEXTVAL, 1, 0, '>=', 99999, #{applyType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dutyNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{affirmLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 1, SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lowLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{highLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 'pa', #{empType, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_PARAM SET REFERENCN_FLAG = 1, REFERENCN_FROM_FLAG = 1, REFERENCN_FROM_OFFSET = 0, REFERENCN_FROM_RELATION = '>=', REFERENCN_TO_FLAG = 1, REFERENCN_TO_OFFSET = 99, REFERENCN_TO_RELATION = '<=', APPLY_TYPE = #{applyType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EMP_TYPE = #{empType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DUTY_NO = #{dutyNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, AFFIRM_LEVEL = #{affirmLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER}, LOW_LEVEL = #{lowLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER}, HIGH_LEVEL = #{highLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER}, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE APPLY_PARAM_NO = #{applyParamNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TYPE = 'pa'
